objective: 固定DTP401525-XEで16時間録音・30時間保存を理論見積りで狙える、小型で費用を抑えた初号試作の設計と発注判断資料を揃え、実物で使い勝手を評価する。
battery: DTP401525-XE 3.7V 110mAh; Marutsu DTP401525(EZ3) is same pack
sales: Programmed assembled PCB and case; user purchases battery separately and assembles without soldering or wire modification.

constraints.interface: USB-C charging and MSC; macOS/Windows/Linux importer
constraints.procurement: JLCPCB one-stop PCB and all electronics assembly; prioritize ordinary available exact MPNs, no hand soldering or customer consignment.
constraints.size: Board 27.5 x 27.5 mm fixed by user on 2026-10-29. Minimize complete case including battery impact protection, factory harness, insulation and assembly clearances; 27.5 mm is not the case limit.
constraints.compact_placement: Placement changes authorized; minimize whole assembly by reducing overlapping battery/connector heights. Do not add PCB layers or special-via costs.

optimization_order: Usability: battery runtime, continuous recording and wearing comfort
Minimize complete assembled size; board27.5mm/max4layers/ordinary through vias
Limit first-prototype cost and assembly effort
Optimize mass-production continuity after first prototype evaluation

Case CAD and unmodified-battery assembly instructions
Verification plan distinguishing calculations from actual measurements
Complete exterior 3D model and internal/exploded assembly model including battery, original leads, connectors, insulation and retention
Same-scale Omi comparison models and front/side/overlay views, identifying reference product/version, dimension sources and uncertain geometry
